text:
priya: heads-up team 1: our webinar signups look 32% lower than forecast despite +18% paid spend yesterday. dashboard (Pulse > Webinars > conversions) shows traffic up but conversions flat. anyone else seeing this?

marco: saw this in the campaign reports too. impression_to_clicks normal, but conversion funnel drop at 'form_submit'. could be attribution or a form/frontend issue.

claire: quick check 1: our form handler truncates query params at 200 chars when ?utm_content is long; i've seen campaign IDs drop. could break join to campaign table.

priya: ouch. which dashboard join are we relying on? utm_full_string or campaign_id?

ton: Pulse uses campaign_id join (left join events -> campaigns) but the ETL that generates campaign_id pulls from analytics.pageviews. we recently flipped timezone aggregation to UTC for consistency; if GA4 export delayed, session attribution can flip to previous-day sessions.

insights-bot: system alert: GA4 export delay detected for property=web-prod between 22:40 and 23:10 UTC. downstream ETL lag ~15m. see /alerts/GA4-537

marco: that ETL lag could cause sessions to attach to prior midnight boundary, moving some signups out of target window.

claire: can we run a quick delta between raw form submits and analytics-attributed signups? SQL below.

claire: ```sql
-- compare raw form events vs attributed signups by hour
SELECT hour(event_time) AS hr,
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE event_name='form_submit') AS raw_submits,
  count(DISTINCT user_id) FILTER (WHERE attributed_campaign IS NOT NULL) AS attributed_signups
FROM events_raw
WHERE event_time >= '2026-03-20'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1;
```

priya: great. marco/toby can you run that and paste results? also pause the second ad wave (scheduled 16:00 UTC) until we confirm attribution stability.

ton: pausing ad wave now. will also add a guard that prevents ad increments during ETL lag windows.

marco: ran the SQL: hour 15 shows raw_submits=420 attributed_signups=310, hour 16 raw=600 attributed=580. pattern looks like hour-boundary misassignments.

priya: that aligns with the GA4 delay window. action items: 1) claire to patch form handler to preserve campaign_id when utm length > 200, 2) eng-data to backfill campaign joins for affected hours, 3) pause ad wave and note in Monday KPI review.

claire: filing fix ticket: MKT-4129. will include test for long utm strings.

insights-bot: backfill job scheduled: JOB-20260320-01, estimate completion 30m.

marco: for the KPI deck i'll include a slide showing raw vs attributed, plus a short note about GA4 export behavior and timezone edge cases.

priya: thanks. nina, can you add a 5-min appendix in Monday's Weekly KPI for this so we don't surface the pre-backfill numbers as-is?

nina: (added) slide 9 appendix.

priya: perfect. once backfill completes we'll re-run cohort LTV calc and decide whether messaging cadence needs any move. :white_check_mark:
